author: Widogeist
body:
64m seems like a lot now, but it's not trust me. At T10, building an Altar of Ascension is 50m orns. Most T10 classes are 15m orns each to unlock, although Grand Summoner is 16m and Deity is 20m. Should you start playing a different class that can use followers, followers beyond T7 cost orns to purchase (between 2m - 5m depending on pet). Building and upgrading your own Towers of Olympia will cost progressively more orns. Also, once you start doing ascension levels, those too will cost progressively more orns (and gold + random mats). 

TL;DR 64m orns isn't a lot once you get to T10. Save them if there isn't anything you immediately need right now, don't blow it on random stuff.

author: dreambig5
body:
Save it for t10. Accumulate tower shards (200k to 1 mil+ shards), get as many pvp wins (blades of finesse, pvp & coliseum) and skeleton keys.I see lot of people rushing t9 to get to t10 (I did it with one of my alts as well). Also, be sure to rack up gold. 5 bil for a lot of the t10 spells you can buy at arcanists. 

I would advise against rushing it. Events will come back later in the year.
